title: The Global Ecology of Scientific Retractions: A Full-Database, Field-Normalized Study of Retraction Dynamics, Causes, and Citation Afterlife
domain: research integrity / metascience / scientometrics / bibliometrics / scholarly communication
summary: A full-Retraction-Watch, all-discipline study that separates counts from rates, models publication-to-retraction lag, maps reason co-occurrence and heterogeneity, and quantifies post-retraction citation persistence using Crossref/OpenAlex enrichment.
